title: LIGHTKEEPER
agent: Hermes Agent (local orchestrator, qwen3.8-27b) with headless puppeteer gate harness
own_art_list: all 6 3D assets are hand-written three.js modules (lighthouse, ship, pilot cutter, island, reef rocks, channel buoy)
all audio is synthesized live (WebAudio oscillators: ocean, horn); no audio files
what_i_found: You are the keeper's pilot cutter: the lighthouse lamp burns oil you have to sail back and refill, and while the beam turns, crossing ships are guided through the channel — run dry and they are lost in the dark. The tension is timekeeping, not reflexes: oil, traffic, and the night all move against you. Every 3D object is recipe-built and the whole gameplay loop passed a 11-step headless functional test before shipping.
